text:
mira: Morning! lost internet mid-standup, switched to phone hotspot. will post before/after desk pics once i sort cables. :sweat_smile:
devin: oof. hotspot saved a meeting for me last week. pro tip: enable your phones personal hotspot and set a simple password before you need it.
kai: also cheap trick: get a tiny travel router and clone your phone hotspot  works better for multiple devices.
ops-bot: FYI: no platform incidents in the past hour. :white_check_mark:
it-support: quick checklist: 1) power-cycle modem/router, 2) check ISP outage map, 3) tether test. DM if you want us to arrange a loaner router.
soph: sharing my tidy desk + power strip label hack later. label everything or your partner will unplug the mic. :joy:
mira: thanks! will try power-cycle now and report back with cat bribe photo if successful. :cat:
